campaign: Integrated validation, phase 2: bounded capability gains and evidence-gated simplification
doctrine:
Owner priority: retain passed model functionality when its execution dependencies, weights, recipe and fixtures are unchanged; advance to the next model's missing capability evidence. E4B modality quality, protocol and resource checks remain accepted. Its unexplained throughput observation is a separate open performance obligation, not a blocker for other models or independent modality acceptance. Reacquire only evidence invalidated by a relevant change or a demonstrated correctness defect. Measurement-only changes do not invalidate functional evidence. Preserve failed speed records without claiming an implementation regression or a performance pass. Diagnose performance only with a quantitative code-cost hypothesis and a discriminating measurement; no repeated probes seeking green. Full performance-catalog acceptance remains separate and retains its numerical requirements. Hatchet implementation is integrated; reduced-scope adoption remains conditional on runtime-input, cache-invalidation and measured-payback acceptance.

Simplify before extending: identify the existing owner and all callers for admission, resolved inputs, execution, receipt validity and finalization. Remove overlapping wrappers and duplicated retry, timeout, release and publication policy in the same repair that migrates their callers. A new forwarding facade, renamed command, hard-coded exception or duplicate state machine is not consolidation. Keep protocol/flag/exit/evidence contracts and the 9964 duplicate-excess ceiling. No new daemon, scheduler, retry executable or public API without demonstrated missing capability and net ownership reduction. The second manual repetition triggers an owner review, not automatic command creation.

Every launched gate has a supervisor through terminal success or an explicit bounded failure. Preserve the attempt and outstanding obligations across supervisor restart; no silent abandonment awaiting a status prompt. Parallel development is normal: live writer contention queues on the existing OS lock and release resumes work. No arbitrary contention timer, polling wrapper, lock stealing or new failure record for ordinary waiting. Propagate caller cancellation or an explicitly declared overall operation budget; never reset that budget on retry. Report waiting separately from failure. Startup and transaction publication share this contract. Resume completed acquisitions and exact valid package receipts; never retry a measured failure into a pass. Reconcile matching recording debt through the existing authority; changed source, conflicting branch/index, foreign live ownership and corrupt evidence refuse without destructive recovery. Record terminal resource release and notify the operator of exhausted or nonrecoverable failures with the exact next action.

Acquisition and promotion are separate: freeze a runnable producer once, persist all compatible cases per model residency, then promote one coherent evidence selection with routine plan updates in that commit. Checkpoints retain implemented, verified and promoted distinctions plus cumulative obligations; current full gates remain mandatory until policy adoption is independently proven. Gate-policy, kernel, concurrency, persistence, authentication and public-contract changes immediately require their existing checks. Semantic thresholds, model floors and evidence authorities never auto-repair into acceptance.

Judge automation by time to accepted model evidence, operator interventions and repeated work over complete attempts, including failures. Report queue, acquisition, verification and finalization wall separately from summed parallel durations; include models reloaded, package checks executed/reused, invalidations and outstanding obligations. Same-input cold/restart comparisons must show fewer unnecessary executions or interventions and no missed seeded regressions before rollout. Inconclusive changes stay in shadow or are removed; do not add a universal speedup constant. CPU-only work holds no GPU lease; correctness shares fitting capacity; isolated measurements acquire exclusion only for their consumer lifetime, never beneath an ancestor's shared lease.

Preserve the capability freeze enforced by structure: no new model family, workflow, optimizer or general orchestration framework. Construction is limited to reproduced defects, missing acceptance in existing owners, regression protection and evidence-backed simplification. Fix causes as work proceeds; missing supported fixtures must be found or built with provenance. Infrastructure commits alone do not count as model validation. Preserve all modality, quality, native-reference, resource and held-out denominators.

docs/plan.json is the sole live execution plan. Retain open row identities and gated historical completion references; depends_on is prerequisite authority and document order ranks ready work. One writer owns each plan edit; publish it with its coherent implementation/evidence batch before handing the updated work to another writer. Keep live rows focused on deliverable, dependencies and executable acceptance; stable policy belongs in its existing authority and historical evidence in OvergoDB/Git, not repeated narrative. Replanning must preserve every outstanding obligation, lower-bound verifier and stop condition. Campaign closure cannot clear an operator stop.

Fix as you go: reproduce, preserve the failing evidence, correct the cause in its existing owner and rerun affected checks. Recording a finding or marking UNAVAILABLE is not completion. Locate, acquire or construct valid missing fixtures with provenance and frozen oracles; never fabricate evidence or credit skipped, absent, incomplete or zero-matching tests. Correctness, security, data-loss and invalid-measurement defects interrupt affected claims; independent authorized work continues. Raw instruction-model NLL alone is not a defect; retain chat-shaped evaluation and matched-checkpoint references. Never normalize failed measurements into healthy baselines.

Retain parity, longform and report checks as lower bounds. Before a dispatched row starts, use plan -setverify to bind any missing assertion in its owning package. Every acceptance names the exact model/task/case denominator, protocols, source and input identities, thresholds and exclusions; freshness, listings and build success alone cannot prove capability. New named tests are implementation obligations and require their files. Gates consume persisted long-campaign evidence rather than rerunning publication. Store paths use the intended canonical OVERGO_DATA_ROOT.

Validate one complete model bundle at a time, deriving supported modes from artifact/projector declarations, recipes, compatibility claims and oracle fixtures. Prepare datasets and native references on CPU; run owning-package CPU contracts, a fixed small end-to-end diagnostic, required GPU parity, then the full quality/protocol/resource denominator. A diagnostic or activation is not model acceptance. Freeze held-out selection and oracles before measurement; group compatible work by residency while preserving warmups, repeats and isolation. Persist each completed evidence cell immediately. Preserve the accepted E4B bundle and apply the same workflow to a second model; measure operator effort, reloads and repeated verification without reducing coverage. Unsupported modes need artifact-bound exclusions; missing supported modes remain repair obligations.

Commit coherent tested producer/repair batches before clean-source canonical publication. Reuse only exact unaffected evidence with a recorded dependency-independence proof. Each evaluate pass has an explicit measured -budget. Keep all 12032 MMLU-Pro cases and both protocols; MATH is excluded. The full 27B pass remains operator-launched with -budget 3h. Existing benchmark admission does not wait for unrelated simplification. Publish the immutable accepted regression guard before broad execution changes, retain the bound baseline-repair prerequisites, and expand/re-accept full-catalog protection after modality validation. Preserve corpus-at-commit, floors, baseline IDs, surface identity and bounded cancellation.

Consolidate shared responsibilities when touching owners: model lookup, admission, resolved inputs and evidence publication should each have one authority. Migrate all callers and remove displaced exports/wrappers in the same batch; preserve protocol/flag/exit/evidence contracts. Repetition triggers an ownership review, not an automatic new executable: first remove the manual step or extend its existing owner. This owner-directed planning rule supersedes the automatic second-use command trigger for this campaign; align skill.md through the existing consolidation row. No new orchestration framework or parallel report format. Command count or file splitting alone is not improvement; measure behavior retained, duplication and maintenance cost removed.

Broad simplification follows the initial modality report, small-model benchmark and each row's regression prerequisites. Preserve the 9964 duplicate-excess ceiling. Compare quality, throughput, peak/retained memory and recovery on identical inputs; no aggregate improvement hides a required regression. Relocation verifies destination and rollback before retiring originals. Retain master ownership of validation/numerics and professional_overgo_gui ownership of HTTP/browser/transport; the audio lane retains its independent plan and development. Use landed intake and integration authorities, without replaying completed merges or importing branch plans.

After model validation, evaluate one bounded existing RSI policy change against a fixed baseline and its ablation on frozen held-out tasks under equal total budgets. Use existing experiment, evaluation, runrecord and report owners. Freeze independent acceptance before candidate generation; the candidate policy cannot alter its judge. Include verification/resource cost, operator interventions, failures and incomplete attempts. A governed loop alone does not prove strategy effectiveness. Negative or inconclusive evidence can close the experiment with an explicit no-promotion decision; it cannot be reported as improvement.

GUI intake boundary: adopt the committed capability projection, media-request lineage, lane dispatch and declared remote-provider contracts described in docs/gui/INTEGRATION.md. Keep GUI/HTTP implementation and its open plan in the GUI lane; master owns validation and numerical/admission repairs. Preserve master's canonical E4B acceptance and data-root contract. Browser, mock relay and hosted generative results prove only their declared contracts; none completes a local model-quality or numerical-parity denominator. Separate remote/backend evidence from reproducible local evidence. Live paid provider evaluation requires explicit authorization. No additional GUI feature work is an E4B prerequisite. Clean-source browser declaration/retirement success and modified-source refusal are distinct evidence dispositions; neither substitutes for the other.

Owner directive: database coordination is a cross-process mutex for a refreshed write transaction, not a server-lifetime reservation. Reuse the OS file-lock owner; no lock daemon. Prove concurrent commits, crash recovery and idle/serving workbench coexistence through transaction-writer and workbench-writer-lifetime before closing the process-control boundary. Recover abandoned gate state through its existing authority under exclusive admission; stale files and process names are never evidence of ownership.

Owner priority 2026-09-07: reduce API surface while implementing each slice. Consolidate duplicated ownership and forwarding wrappers; migrate callers atomically and remove displaced paths. Prefer fewer operations with clear contracts, not new facades over duplicate implementations. Record net exported surface and preserved caller behavior; do not delay validation for an unrelated broad rewrite.

Committed GUI conversation recovery and CPU audio production/segmentation contracts are integrated. Keep newer lane work and lane plans separate. Reuse production audio consumers and preserve the open native audio streaming admission; integrated infrastructure is not model-quality acceptance.

Lane coordination: master owns the reproduced evidence-commit recovery repair now, then returns to model/modality validation. Hatchet retains selective testing and broader scheduling work. Share the boundary through the plan; do not implement competing owners or take unsafe/open lane code. Review committed improvements against counterexamples and preserve changed-source-first execution, exact evidence reuse and interactive GPU sharing.

Lock release is OS-owned, not timer-owned: normal/error exits close the exact acquired handle; cancellation drains pending acquisition; process death releases ownership. Exercise an already queued waiter on owner death, release racing cancellation, repeated release and reacquisition. Never unlink or replace an owned lock file, infer abandonment from heartbeat age, or release another process's reservation. Resource-completion output follows actual release and reports the released resource, not a claim that all resources are idle.

Change-specific verification: resolve one auditable set from changed symbols, compiled/test imports, runtime files and execution edges. Use binding-aware AST/type analysis; a syntax match, package annotation or safe assignment is not proof of isolation. Unknown calls and control-flow joins retain conservative scope. Check selection and receipt identity must share the same resolved inputs. Every selected or reused check reports its reason and input identity. Run cheap deterministic refusals before expensive work; persist independent terminal passes immediately. Unchanged model acquisition survives unrelated browser, plan and gate changes. Gate-policy changes retain the existing full acceptance scope while proposed exclusions run in shadow. Adopt exclusions only after seeded regressions are detected and measured repeated work falls. Ordinary contention waits for release or caller cancellation; report queue time separately. Integration batches preserve durable outstanding obligations and mandatory escalation. No scheduler expansion is prerequisite to these changes or independent model validation.

Storage efficiency: reuse equivalent input-bound analyses, package results and immutable snapshot content before changing the physical layout. Measure bounded append-only packs for small records with a rebuildable content-hash-to-offset index; keep large payloads separate. Copy only new immutable segments and the captured active extent. Preserve content IDs, per-record checksums, crash recovery, concurrent readers and serialized conflicting publication. Derive segment sizes from measured publication, lookup, backup and recovery costs. No duplicate snapshot or test acquisition merely because a process restarted.

Incremental improvement: keep current model validation moving while observations of repeated verification, recovery or resource cost identify bounded improvements through existing plan and evidence owners. Coalesce observations and preserve prior failed approaches, exact results, outstanding checks and cumulative cost. Admit one useful correction at a time; no controller rewrite or scheduler prerequisite. Proposal policy may evolve, but each experiment retains its frozen acceptance and operator ceilings. Rejection, waiting for a named trigger and no useful action are valid outcomes. Prefer measured reuse and policy consolidation before new mechanisms. Documentation efficiency is an early beneficiary; retain affected documentation contracts and runtime consumers without unrelated acquisition.

Operational state is typed data in existing JSON contracts or OvergoDB records: plans, obligations, measurements, dispositions and recovery positions must not depend on parsing Markdown. Do not automatically create ad hoc Markdown status, plan, handoff or result files. Keep human-facing README, skill instructions and necessary reference documentation concise. Render human reports on demand from authoritative structured records; avoid duplicate persisted snapshots. Migrate existing consumers and retain evidence identities, provenance and required release contracts before retiring a generated document. File-extension replacement alone is not consolidation.

Operator-directed documentation boundary: ordinary README.md, skill.md and top-level docs Markdown run document acceptance without package, model, device or browser suites. Compiler-embedded or explicitly named runtime Markdown remains a software input; nested fixtures/evidence, assets and mixed source edits retain existing runtime scope. The live plan retains admission, bound acceptance and atomic advancement. This narrow policy precedes general call-reach proof; unknown runtime I/O still broadens software changes. Selection and receipt inputs share this classification. Exclusions grant no fresh package or model evidence; retained model results keep their frozen producer and input identities. Gate policy changes force the pre-existing full integration scope before adoption. Measure complete attempts, including planning and commit cost; zero runtime suites is the first milestone, not a claim of zero total wall time.

steps.title: Verify chat, embedding, rerank and vision-language activations
steps.rationale:
Run the existing smoke, embedding, rerank, vqaparity and sensenovaparity owners against declared oracles on the current landed execution surface. Reuse exact unaffected committed text evidence; run missing/invalidated cases only. Bind the exact models, tasks, fixtures, budgets and read-only evidence assertion before starting. Missing oracles remain explicit findings, never successful coverage. Dispatch contract: bind executable assertions for the exact required denominator, identities, protocols, thresholds and outcomes described above before work starts. If missing, add the smallest read-only assertion to the existing owner and prove its failing counterexample before publishing evidence. A bare freshness/listing/lane command cannot close this row. Collect and consume complete per-model bundles across applicable modalities; task-group rows are final coverage joins, not a reason to reload every model or recommit already accepted evidence. Include input modalities under inference, even when the activation task name is not VQA or media generation.

Required read-only acceptance: TestAcceptedTextVisionEvidence in cmd/compatibility/accepted_modalities_test.go. Implement this bound assertion before the row can close; it must reject an omitted required cell, duplicate case, stale identity and failed required outcome using the stated denominator, protocols and thresholds. The final join reads bound evidence; it does not rerun the complete smoke lane. Preserve the smoke case and oracle requirements in per-model evidence checks. Aggregate existing per-model evidence and acquire only missing or invalidated cells; do not rebuild an evaluation engine or launch long benchmarks from this assertion.

Current bundle: corrected MiniCPM model 3007c05b8ece556726a37980069cf6c0f1f966a48572b1c130c5643810c23a32, declared chat protocol. MMLU abstract-algebra 100/100 scored, accuracy 0.26, evidence:sha256:f55dc094513358a89f795262ae70db434b52f51825a4495dbe3194f60f7d0a60. This is measured quality, not native parity or full-model acceptance. MMLU-Pro completed 12032/12032 cases in 421.409s, accuracy 0.29130651595744683, evidence:sha256:7eaedf641d5a8f51cd1495ad66fbabf213bd29a17fd9a492d28b1fd9238ac49f. Preserve the exact subject metrics and chat protocol; no native-parity or full-model acceptance claim. Do not reacquire these evaluations for a smoke-command-only change.

Preserve MiniCPM BBH 5761/5761 (evidence:sha256:fee6ec46595eab51e1f9975f8920ab3c8b7126e9e5bdf445806b3c43d44ebcb3), MuSR 756/756 (evidence:sha256:4cc9db91a0dd52367871c6f664455a650cfd5a4b231a302a6460a9228286be75) and IFEval supported subset 131/541 (evidence:sha256:59f9c13f5b2a01b391d0bc68090067e714b32f16b319add9d4194a8cd9bd2745). IFEval's 410 omitted cases remain a compiler/native-parity repair obligation, finding evidence:sha256:919679b30fb4935c7f3d7b9cdd7af9886a5c1c65612eb7040a886fb24def0e40; partial scores cannot close full coverage. Qwen9 chat MuSR refused its first eight generated answers, finding evidence:sha256:a3fee6c06273c351e0e506bc2180066fa6c943ea5bc5e6a64894418eaf00a4ba. Resolve with a bounded matched-checkpoint prompt/protocol comparison before full acquisition; no blind retry or extraction relaxation. FP8 chat MMLU-Pro acquisition completed; retain the bound result below.

Corrected MiniCPM selected smoke passed from clean 6a783ee4: run:sha256:ff7b4807da4336342ff9b293d518f424a7d0e5b03012f83dcef8b37ea4d5f98a, outcome evidence:sha256:7a3a4213b0bd6a2dde2dbbc36cc77fd1bfd5832362c5f87782800b5a7791f53c. One exact arithmetic claim passed; eight models omitted without credit. Preserve this evidence for discovery-only changes. Continue missing native-reference and supported quality coverage; smoke is not complete model acceptance.

FP8 Gemma12 chat-template MMLU-Pro completed: 12032 observations, 12032 unique cases, accuracy 0.492436835106383, scoring 50m46s. Bound evidence evidence:sha256:acbce9abc5492096c44be7f597e1acec5d108ef27a501f13eba04dfece8a96ac validates immutable plan/run/report/metric lineage; recipe 25268b97718fcd611d83280c93c66aaf9676a2063fb7fc767fb8f917131e6254, frozen producer f278ca230121df1d0bedf8fc58bf7881a9ebc475. Preserve all subject scores. This completes that quality acquisition, not native parity or whole-model acceptance. Discovery and progress-output changes cannot invalidate this completed scoring evidence.

Qwen MuSR numerical diagnosis: original evidence:sha256:78e593bb49168957ec406afdd2f7b024d14f27705cc0fae5a1853aea13f2e58c binds identical 1301-token inputs at pinned llama.cpp 42fc2430 and Go f278ca23. Native first-token margin 0.098831 reverses under Go; full-logit RMSE 0.3516783422. Head isolation evidence:sha256:6eafefc4291c3be7040c0d4cb1ce0084af52c154589fe3f6517a8c2c337b8a49 reproduces all 248320 native logits exactly. On the same native hidden state, double-accumulation projections with and without Q8 activation quantization both select native token 2972; Go selects 3018. Head quantization RMSE 0.0159947 leaves Go/reference RMSE 0.3513085: it cannot alone explain the reversal. Next distinguish Go head arithmetic from upstream hidden-state differences using the retained 4096-value hidden vector and identical checkpoint weights; do not rerun full MuSR or change answer extraction. Three CPU loads took 99.579 seconds total, including two failed collectors corrected to handle zero-output microbatches; all receipts remain retained. This diagnostic grants no model or numerical-parity promotion.

Retain acquired Mini and Gemma FP8 outputs across automation-only edits. IFEval scorer parity remains open: finding evidence:sha256:6c64908ea1e4678e62ab21ca3b32c0d289ec2da4ab0b17937eda1f538207c0d1 records incorrect case/boundary, fenced-JSON, suffix and quotation semantics. Native diagnostic rescoring of the existing 131 Mini responses gives 156 native instructions versus 174 Go entries, with 8 strict and 5 loose prompt disagreements; 410 of 541 prompts remain unsupported. Correct the IFEval-specific compiler/scorer against pinned lm_eval 0.4.9.1, preserving generic rule semantics. Derive explicit new scorer lineage from retained raw responses instead of regenerating them; acquire only missing cases. Do not promote old partial IFEval scores as reference-compatible. The four-case corrected Mini native diagnostic matches all 82 generated token IDs across 48 input tokens; promote only after the fixture and native provenance are bound, including the exact BF16-vector widening used by the CPU reference.

IFEval protocol finding evidence:sha256:a15f177c75ad76f8576cdf3d14b0a9793e7be03cc8aed92b3ee29487d836e66c records the former 256-token cap. The MiniCPM integration batch corrects it to the pinned lm_eval 0.4.9.1 task v4.0 cap of 1280 and counts quotation as one instruction, with seven native strict/loose cases and distinct evaluator identities. The source trace and CUDA natural-EOG acceptance support reusing 97 terminal responses under the unchanged execution/protocol contract. Preserve all 131 old outputs: 34 hit the former cap and 410 native inputs remain ungenerated. Reacquire or extend those 444 cases only after the remaining scorer repairs are accepted; do not rerun the model battery. Native oracle evidence:sha256:5064dd02f3c1809b0750fdfc88290c2fbc0c8e3110686c703ea5dfba6a8748f1 retains 59 deliberately adversarial checker cases and capture/native-task inputs. The quotation fix leaves 26 checker disagreements plus unsupported instructions and native language detection open. These are scorer counterexamples, not model-quality scores; no complete IFEval promotion yet.

This row closes only with the existing full performance-catalog assertion: eight live models, retained retired history, matching immutable identities and protocols, complete required cohorts and unchanged quality/rate/resource bounds. Functional acceptance and performance acceptance are separate claims. Reuse unaffected evidence; never relabel a failed speed result as accepted.

The gated audio intake also assigns NewTextTransform, PublishInputProjection and RestoreInputProjection here. Their CPU publication and fresh-process resume tests prove a frozen one-row adapter boundary, not production assembly, held-out WER, HTTP recovery, promotion or GPU training. Keep development in the audio lane. At its next finalized intake, TestNativeAudioProductionIntake must exercise all three APIs through the landed production consumer with exact base/transform/checkpoint/corpus identities, successful resume and rejected mismatches; bind its denominator and applicable quality/resource acceptance before dispatch. The new named test is an implementation obligation. Retain TestASRAdapterPublicationAcceptance and TestASRExactResumeAcceptance as lower bounds, never as substitutes for production use. Close this row only after every assigned staged API has a verified production consumer or has been atomically removed with all callers. This follow-up does not block E4B waveform validation.

The e36c3103 intake supplies the implementation and six CPU acceptance families. Reuse its passing evidence and remove only obsolete staged declarations; do not rebuild the landed streaming, switching, alignment or attribution owners. Retain the existing integration and production-intake lower bounds and independently scoped hardware, held-out quality and transport obligations.

items.title: Reduce repeated verification through one sound dependency owner

steps.title: Adopt reduced scope only after equivalent detection and measured savings
steps.rationale:
Compare cold and resumed attempts over the same docs/plan-only, browser, unit-test, runtime fixture, model-execution, kernel and gate-policy change matrix. Inject regressions and refuse any selection that misses a failure detected by the retained required scope. Measure wall to commit, preparation/queue/check/finalization time, executed/reused packages, model loads, outstanding checks and interventions. The 91537691 gate took 1270.6 seconds and executed 234 packages with zero reuse. Hatchet merge fd3a3250 took 1080.7 seconds with 7 reused and 226 executed packages; 154 opaque readers retained broad scope. The preceding browser failure took 925.1 seconds with 233 executed and zero reused packages. Use these concrete incidents, not a universal throughput floor. Publish through existing gate cost/evidence owners. Include merge snapshot preparation: this intake copies a source store with 117099 blobs; measure copying, syncing and replay before choosing immutable snapshot reuse or incremental backup. Preserve verified store ancestry and crash integrity. No recurring full benchmark merely to validate gate savings. Adoption may proceed independently of the modality report; broader batching still retains its recovery and promotion prerequisites. Prioritize ordinary documentation and plan edits: target seconds-scale publication and measure the ratio against the 1006.894-second documentation incident; 100x is an operator optimization target, not permission to omit required checks or a claimed result. Separate prose/assets from embedded inputs, fixtures, generated contracts and executable policy. Remove the recurring requirement to edit Go task-ID lists for routine plan additions while retaining substantive campaign constraints. Resolve non-Go consumer ownership before narrowing lanes; file extensions alone cannot authorize exclusion. Include preparation and finalization in the comparison. Make browser acceptance granular through the existing webui-lane -run selector: bind each journey to its component/route, shared shell, JavaScript/CSS dependencies and consumed HTTP contracts. Shared authentication, session and protocol changes widen to their consumers; unresolved reach retains the complete lane. Reuse independent scenario receipts across sibling failure and restart. Bind each selector to its owning package and refuse missing, skipped or zero-match targets. Prepare browser/server/model/GPU resources only for selected journeys that consume them. No second UI scheduler, policy list or receipt authority. Compare selected and full runs with seeded component, navigation and authentication regressions before adoption. Eliminate routine report-Markdown regeneration as a source of unrelated gate invalidation: consume existing typed report identities, distinguish a requested rendered view from authoritative state, and demonstrate unchanged evidence remains reusable. Preserve frozen long-form corpus identities when documentation changes; do not silently change an accepted corpus. Treat scheduling overlap separately from reduced test scope: record actual total cost and unchanged check coverage, and do not credit the browser/package overlap as solved opaque-input selection or package-evidence reuse.

Landed documentation measurement: 7367a3f8 completed the README and plan publication gate in 87.434 seconds, versus 153.329 seconds for 7589ed77. Runtime package, GPU and browser executions were all zero; modern-Go 17.901 seconds, bound acceptance 7.623 seconds, document checks 6.577 seconds and finalization 12.213 seconds. No competing analysis probes were run by this session during the measurement. This improves elapsed cost but does not meet the seconds-scale target. Gate-policy adoption 857fef83 took 1410.360 seconds after the browser contention repair, with 230 package executions and zero reuse; address the measured source-scope invalidation and static-analysis cost before claiming broad development-speed improvement. Preserve MiniCPM captures across these automation-only changes.

steps.title: Prove which tests can reach runtime reads and subprocesses
steps.rationale:
Hatchet 8a052b5b contributes runtime-input classification, package identities and independent receipts. The integration repairs reproduced function-alias, go-option and conditional-assignment gaps; these are lower bounds, not complete soundness proof. Extend existing gate/repoanalysis owners with binding-aware call reachability. Prove positive isolation before excluding an importer. Cover shadowed names, reassigned and escaped function values, receiver/interface calls, closures, conditional/loop joins, caller annotations, go flags/argument vectors and indirect launchers. Unresolved calls broaden the affected dependency boundary. Use the same graph for selecting packages and invalidating receipts. Seed a failing consumer for every relevant mutation and require both selection and identity invalidation; unrelated consumers retain identities. No whole-program optimizer or new analysis wrapper. Merge changes to gate policy keep the pre-existing full acceptance scope. Binding hardening is a separate prerequisite: annotation comments cannot waive unknown caller inputs. Retain its eleven seeded-consumer counterexamples. Positive call-site isolation must demonstrate actual repository exclusions with equivalent failure detection before adding more analysis machinery; a conservative hardening pass alone does not close this row. Require a baseline-versus-candidate selection comparison on the actual repository before the long commit gate. Withdrawn lexical-path candidate finding evidence:sha256:caaf1d565556bd5b084e02dbc4aae6d9c3860b1936bcae5fb8afd591833ec55f showed 230 to 231 selected packages and zero exclusions in four real change cases; its copied-owner fixture did not prove incremental benefit. Do not repeat that candidate without resolving the causal graph boundary and demonstrating net useful reduction.

Typed-reach feasibility finding evidence:sha256:47af76959b96997c195c6bf0b043b63cf1340a8314f8684ddc71130cf668cd98: 11 potential exclusions from 230 selected tracked packages for a README edit; gate and audio groups remained selected. No reduced selector or speedup was accepted. Method binding alone does not justify an adoption gate. Next resolve temporary fixture roots through arguments and returned owners, plus subprocess working directories; preserve conservative treatment of unresolved effects. The closure diagnostic repair belongs in the same integration batch. Probe output SHA256 a58d738fe2df1e1ea0e5b2f7f29009116cefc64450f03aa71b19216fab69d40d.

verification_batch.rationale: Keep selector implementation and seeded counterexamples in one integration batch. Run focused checks while editing; defer the full integration gate until the candidate demonstrates useful repository-level exclusions. The operator-requested diagnostic commit is a completed prerequisite, not reduced-scope adoption.
verification_batch.reopen_when: Reopen affected checks when their implementation, runtime inputs, environment or verification contract changes. Unresolved reach retains existing coverage. Checkpoints do not advance the parent row or authorize reduced scope.

items.title: Reuse immutable evidence without copying every small file

steps.title: Measure and decide whether to pack small immutable records
steps.rationale: The current evidence descriptor census includes 68385 text/plain records totaling 10801019 bytes, 27609 closure-ledger records totaling 29217663 bytes, and 1070 code-manifest-analysis records totaling 1110797445 bytes. Descriptor counts include retained content not necessarily stored as separate blobs; keep physical and logical denominators separate. Compare the retained layout plus snapshot reuse against append-only packs for small immutable records with hash-indexed offsets and separate large payloads. Reuse the existing OvergoDB segment/index owners. Measure publication, reopen, random lookup, backup and concurrent-writer costs with actual size distributions. A retained-layout decision may close this row with evidence and a reopen trigger; packing is not mandatory. If adopted, prove torn-write and crash recovery, per-record integrity, safe index rebuild, source-independent backup, old-store readability and reversible migration before promotion. Preserve immutable IDs and referenced history. Derive packing boundaries from measurements, never an arbitrary file-count target. Reuse source-bound manifest analysis and package receipts; compact physical storage without suppressing distinct failures or obligations.

items.title: Stabilize evidence commits; defer broader control policy until model evidence

steps.title: Certify the complete evidence workflow across producer and supervisor crashes
steps.verify: go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestBatchEvidencePublicationFailure|TestTerminalEvidenceRestart|TestRecoverInterruptedStateCrashRetryBoundaries|TestAbandonedGateAdmission)$' -count=1 && test -f internal/gate/evidence_commit_recovery_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestEvidenceCommitRecoveryAcceptance$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/overgodb -run '^(TestOpenContextWriterAdmission|TestTransactionWriter|TestSecondWriterFailsClosed)$' -count=1 && test -f internal/gate/evidence_commit_workflow_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestEvidenceCommitWorkflow$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Certify the complete producer-to-commit workflow after modality evidence. store-lifetime and admission-recovery own the reproduced handle, startup and recording failures; reuse their implementation and tests. Their synthetic receipt and committed-transaction fixtures do not complete this broader acceptance. No new global prerequisite for model validation.

Use an isolated repository/store, counted acquisition stubs and immutable captures. Inject writer contention before receipt publication, kill before/after persistence, supervisor restart, and interruption between Git commit and final store recording. Completed durable acquisitions must not repeat; interrupted work without a durable result gets no completion credit, and necessary re-execution remains visible in cost. Resume exact unaffected receipts, execute every outstanding required check before promotion, reconcile matching debt, and prove one accepted commit, one plan advance and one final record. Preserve attempts/obligations across restart without manual reconstruction or waiting for a status prompt. Use OS release events; preserve caller cancellation and any explicitly declared overall budget without resetting it on retry.

Refuse changed candidate inputs, invalid receipt reuse across environments, foreign live ownership and corrupt or mismatched authority without destructive changes. Historical finalization retains its original verified environment and may publish without new acquisition; it cannot accept changed current work. Keep existing parity, persistence, interrupted-state and terminal-evidence checks as lower bounds. Do not retry semantic/measurement failure into a pass.

Map existing admission, supervision, publication, retry and finalization callers before editing. Consolidate displaced wrappers/policy with their callers through gate, driver/loop, processcontrol, runrecord and OvergoDB; no new command, daemon, scheduler, receipt schema or forwarding facade. Report exact real/synthetic case counts, acquisitions/reloads, executed/reused checks, outstanding obligations, commit/finalization counts, operator interventions and queue/execution/finalization wall. Compare the same incident inputs and retain failed attempts. Split only at a concrete failure boundary; this parent stays open until the full workflow proof passes.

steps.title: Promote batching only after recovery, safe selection and measured payback
steps.verify: go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestPreflightReportsValidateFindings|TestPreflightSeparatesSkippedChecks|TestPreflightNeverRepairsStore|TestPreflightRejectsCombinedInspection|TestGateStartIndexAdoptsStatRefreshUnderSameTree|TestGateStartIndexRefusesAndPreservesLaterUnplannedStaging)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestCheckpointPersistenceSurvivesKill|TestCheckpointMemoCoversEveryCommand|TestChangeSelectiveVerificationShadow|TestBatchedGateCostEvidence)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestIndependentPackageEvidenceAcceptance|TestGovernedBatchDeclarationAcceptance|TestProjectedMergePreflightBeforeVerification|TestGateReusesUnchangedCheckEvidence|TestPackageSelectiveReuse)$' -count=1 && test -f internal/gate/batch_promotion_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestBatchPromotionControl$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestReusedCheckpointCompletionAuthorityAcceptance$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/repoanalysis -run '^(TestDocsHoldNoUnplannedBinaries|TestDocsInventoryPolicy)$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestPreflightRejectsUnplannedDocsBeforeStore$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestChangeSelectionUnownedRuntimeInputs$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/plan -run '^TestBatchFlush' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestCandidateGoPhasesExcludeIgnoredSource$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestBatchEvidence' -count=1 && go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestChangedPackageFailurePreventsBroadSweep|TestModernGoPreflightBindsCandidateCensus|TestStaticFailurePreventsAcceptance|TestGateRunsStaticChecksBeforeAcceptance|TestCheckpointEvidenceReuseAcrossRuns|TestPackageSelectiveReuse|TestTerminalEvidenceRestart)$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Existing checkpoint memo, independent package receipts, transaction recovery, shared GPU admission, input preflight, candidate isolation and terminal-obligation owners are lower bounds, not features to rebuild. Retain every existing verifier, checkpoint and escalation obligation. The new evidence-commit-recovery prerequisite owns immediate reliability repair; this row owns later policy integration. Broad concurrency, automatic scheduling and reduced gates remain deferred until this row proves safe adoption after the modality report.

Selection must follow actual compiled dependencies, fixtures, runtime files, subprocesses, renames/deletions, build tags, toolchain, device mode and resolved environment. Unknown reach broadens verification, including required fixture/device tests; it does not justify a short-only downgrade. Before adopting Hatchet classification, add counterexamples for os.Args[1], reassignment and shadowing, aliased os/exec imports, caller-supplied paths, indirect launchers, command argument construction, embedded inputs and repository-level fixtures. Use binding-aware analysis or conservative fallback; textual identifier names, one safe assignment, file extensions and package-wide caller annotations cannot establish independence. Shadow-compare the complete historical/injected-failure matrix against the current full gate: no omitted required checks, missed seeded regression or stale receipt. Policy changes cannot validate themselves using their proposed reduced scope.

Persist each terminal package success independently as it finishes, even if a sibling fails, skips or is killed. Reuse requires exact input/environment/contract identities; a failed write retries receipt publication, not acquisition. Retain cumulative obligations across kill/restart, replan, scope expansion and branch changes. Never credit skipped, unavailable, unfinished or zero-match tests; acquire required fixtures and distinguish explicit unsupported-platform exclusions. Scratch retry files remain projections of OvergoDB authority. Include interrupted replacement of gate_cache.json and independent successful packages beside failed/unavailable siblings.

Prepare mechanical derived authorities before freezing the candidate, then run cheap deterministic refusals before expensive acceptance and packages. Bind both baseline and published census to the staged candidate. Preserve the same resolved dataset roots between acceptance and package tests. Mechanical preparation may regenerate manifests/censuses from existing reviewed policy; it cannot change semantic literal exceptions, floors or adjudication. Recompute candidate identity after preparation; reject later drift. Keep preflight read-only and nonpromoting. Repeat deterministic evidence assertions without silently repeating independent model acquisition; preserve compound-command coverage and every required repeat.

Consolidate resource and supervision policy through existing processcontrol, driver and gate owners. Prove CPU work holds no GPU lease; correctness users coexist; an exclusive measurement child is never blocked by an ancestor's shared lease; publication holds only its write transaction; process/child death releases ownership. Never infer abandonment from heartbeat age or process names. Preserve physical identity across stores/worktrees, bounded waiting, cancellation causes and task-completion resource output. No second package-ownership list, wait loop, launcher or recovery state machine.

Only after these proofs, integrate implemented/checkpointed, verified and promoted transitions through the existing gate. Test refusal with outstanding checks; exact source/index/HEAD and immutable lineage; restart/replan without orphaned obligations; mandatory escalation; final full integration; elapsed-only flush with no new checkpoint; trailing obligations; exact boundaries and empty/negative/overflow/pre-origin refusal. Keep BatchFlush.Advance as the transition owner; no duplicate accumulator or reset authority. Privatize gate-only cost helpers and remove displaced callers atomically. Retain reviewed exclusions from prior lane intakes; no open lane plan or previously refused policy is implicitly imported.

Measure cold and resumed runs on the same representative change matrix, including an evidence-only E4B selection, a test change, fixture/runtime input change, kernel and gate-policy change. Report full wall, wait, acquisition, checks, publication, repeated loads, package reuse, outstanding obligations and operator interventions; do not equate summed phase time with elapsed savings. Require reduced repeated work/intervention with identical regression detection; otherwise keep the old policy. The E4B 935.2-second gate executed 234 packages with zero package reuse after a 97.1-second database-lock failure: use that incident to drive a controlled counterexample, not a universal performance threshold.

Retained open incident authorities (closure requires their own evidence): evidence:sha256:0f4b6d07607b3fa8ee6ee7f320646e5dbbd5b38b025a19c2046d54aed7fa4b4e, evidence:sha256:13a4473eab084e75be2c92ffc5bb6a8544fe78e3c6edd04abf2dd3a8c3be00db, evidence:sha256:42f5196b3d02c67f3de8e67ee22f5bcbde3e4673e6d6059e2c052900def5dfc5, evidence:sha256:5907e3a581c7ee0151f63a42454a0b576b90735054c1969518d410e07f944795.

After Hatchet intake, validation-gate-selection owns immediate call-reach, shared scope and measured adoption. Reuse its receipts and tests here; do not reimplement that work. The modality-report prerequisite applies to broad batch promotion, not to the independent selector improvements.

verification_batch.rationale: One existing-owner process-control integration, subdivided into bounded acceptance checkpoints. Inspect existing resource and persistence owners before editing; explicitly amend scope if another owner is required. Existing bound tests remain lower bounds. New named tests below are implementation obligations, not claims that these capabilities already pass. Migrate cmd/test-lane with the shared streaming evidence contract; it is an existing consumer, not a new test runner.
verification_batch.reopen_when: Cumulative source, transitive dependencies, fixtures, resolved environment, resource identity, required acceptance or scope changes invalidate the affected evidence and reopen durable obligations. Checkpoints never complete the parent.

items.title: Bound retained device memory across changing context capacities

steps.title: Bound retained device memory across changing context capacities
steps.rationale: The E4B ladder reportedly grew from 14 GB loaded to 39 GB after rung 32768. Treat graph executables, runner caches and pool free lists as hypotheses; instrument their live/retained byte accounting before changing ownership. Bind a failing repeated grow-shrink-grow context sequence in one long-lived runner/server. Cancellation, errors, release and reload must recover resources; synchronize before comparing counters. items.title: Recover small-head decode throughput without losing long-context correctness

steps.title: Recover small-head decode throughput without losing long-context correctness

Bind both kernel parity and end-to-end Qwen/E4B assertions. Remove capacity-wide work and redundant transfers before introducing another dispatch policy; retain one shared path wherever parity permits. The MiniCPM guard repair now owns the initial block-width split derivation and per-split shared allocation. steps.title: Provide the missing typed rollout-plan authoring path
steps.rationale: Address finding c9c88020 through recipe rollout-plan using the existing committed rollout contract: baseline, candidate, admission/cohort evidence and rollback authority. steps.title: Exercise rollback, quarantine, peer failures and durable workflow recovery
steps.rationale:
Use scratch stores/peers to exercise escalation, candidate quarantine and evidence-bound re-entry, exact predecessor rollback, peer timeout/partial response and workflow restart with persistent obligations. Inject failure before and after side effects/receipt publication; assert state, lineage, idempotence and absence of duplicate mutations. Remaining caller coverage: inventory production nonblocking OvergoDB.Open uses and migrate normal service/command startup to the existing OpenContext entry point with the caller's cancellation, retaining immediate refusal only for intentional probes. Gate admission/recovery and closure publication are handled by admission-recovery; reuse that owner and its release/cancellation tests. Do not add caller-specific retry loops, timers or wrappers. Bind live workbench plus simultaneous writers, normal completion, error, queued cancellation and process death; report remaining unmigrated callers. This follow-up cannot force re-acquisition of unrelated completed model evidence.

Prove release-triggered progress under expected parallel contention. Bind queued writers to actual OS ownership; process death releases ownership without stale-file or PID-age heuristics. Cover release before waiter registration, release during cancellation, multiple queued writers, duplicate cleanup, and a surviving child that still owns work. Cancellation must drain pending native waits before returning; publish not_busy only after owned handles are released. Recheck the ownership predicate after every wakeup; notifications alone never authorize a write. Distinguish the landed Windows store-writer completion wait from the still-polled GPU AwaitResource admission path. Inventory remaining polling in its existing owner, replace it only with a proved release/process-lifetime trigger, and preserve shared correctness admission plus isolated performance runs. Do not claim all resource waits are event-driven, introduce per-caller retries, or use elapsed time as evidence that an owner is dead.

Capture bounded diagnostics and classify timeout explicitly. This host-only drill can run independently of model benchmarks, but must not contend with production gate/store locks.

Reuse the evidence-commit-recovery integration and its persisted receipts; this row extends the existing transaction-boundary drill, never introduces a second supervisor or recovery path. Include a semantic failure that must not be retried, and preserve exact failure diagnostics.

steps.title: Remove costly execution duplication behind the regression gate

items.title: Consolidate measured command duplication after validation consumers finish

steps.title: Consolidate duplicated ownership and remove unnecessary automation surface
steps.rationale:
Inventory actual overlapping wrappers rather than assume a fixed command count. Fold probe/lane/parity entrypoints into typed subcommands only where ownership/maintenance cost falls; preserve every behavior, flag contract, exit code and evidence path. Keep plan, gate, loop and hook commands. Atomically update plan verifiers, CI, scripts, API manifest and docs with an old-to-new invocation map; no later row may reference a removed command. Keep README's transport descriptions aligned with registered adapters. Validate all migrated invocation contracts plus representative real dispatch and record the reduced command/duplication ceilings. Avoid rerunning expensive model suites when an exact implementation-independence proof permits evidence reuse. Consolidate only shared responsibilities whose callers can migrate atomically with lower measured maintenance cost; distinct responsibilities remain separate. Command-count reduction alone is not acceptance.

Select the first consolidation from measured duplicated responsibilities in model lookup, admission, input resolution or evidence publication. Freeze the caller/contract inventory and before cost; migrate every affected caller, remove the displaced implementation and prove equivalent success/refusal/exit/evidence behavior through TestOwnershipConsolidationContracts in internal/apimanifest. Assert that generated invocation references resolve and duplicate ownership cannot reappear. A renamed executable or a new dispatcher around unchanged duplication is insufficient.

Align skill.md durable automation policy with the campaign decision: the second manual repetition triggers review of the existing owner, not mandatory creation of another command. Prefer removal of manual work or extension of an existing typed operation; require demonstrated recurring need and explicit ownership before admitting a new public entrypoint. Preserve deterministic verification and durable receipts. Include this policy alignment and net surface/caller accounting in the same bounded consolidation; broader HTTP implementation remains GUI-owned.

Include the landed providerintake, remoteprovider, remoterelay and modelrecipe admission paths in the ownership census. Consolidate duplicated model lookup, credentials or admission only when measured duplication and atomic caller migration justify it; keep provider declaration, credential storage and wire transport responsibilities explicit. Coordinate HTTP caller migration with the GUI lane. Do not add a new public wrapper or defer E4B to perform this cleanup.

The earlier evidence-commit-recovery slice owns narrowly necessary gate-wrapper removal; consume its ownership map rather than inventory or implement it again. This later row handles only remaining measured duplication. Delete displaced retry, timeout, input-resolution and evidence-publication policy with all callers; require end-to-end success/refusal/cancellation/exit/evidence parity and lower ownership/surface cost. Do not add wrapper-count targets or a new registry.

Audit automatic Markdown writers and their readers in benchmark-report, compatibility (model/media/training), api-manifest, plan sync, preflight and release. Prefer existing typed JSON/OvergoDB results as the single operational authority; machine consumers must not scrape prose. Remove stray generated plans/status/handoffs and redundant report persistence with all callers, while retaining deliberate human documentation and third-party model cards/licenses. Keep optional report rendering explicit. Bind migration acceptance to structured schema validation, equivalent decisions and denominators, missing/invalid record refusal, release/link contracts and absence of unsolicited Markdown writes. Do not create a parallel JSON file for every retired Markdown file or duplicate stored results.

items.title: Remove dependence on retired checkpoint paths with reversible relocation

steps.title: Remove dependence on retired checkpoint paths with reversible relocation
steps.rationale: After initial validation and the regression gate, relocate live checkpoints from adaptive_new under overgo/models through the existing location owner. First inventory identity, bytes, all live references and destination capacity; verify a staged destination before switching store locators. Keep the original until hash/size, recipe/servable identity, baseline lookup by content ID, bounded load/inference and rollback all pass. Do not rewrite historical evidence or delete original bytes prematurely. Regenerate current reports/fixtures, and assert every expected model remains present and no live reference requires the retired root. A successful -servable listing alone does not prove no model vanished. Remove stale locator duplication first. Move checkpoint bytes only where an active dependency on the retired location remains and relocation removes demonstrated operational cost; directory neatness alone is not a capability gain.

steps.title: Prove the final text execution surface and long-lived serving behavior
steps.rationale: On the settled execution surface, run full-catalog text regression against the pinned before-baseline, with both framing protocols, required context/head/cache coverage and useful smoke assertions. Exercise a bounded long-lived server sequence covering concurrency, grow/shrink contexts, cancellation, failure, model reload and subsequent valid requests; assert retained VRAM plateaus within the declared budget and outputs remain correct. Reuse valid committed generation-soak evidence only with exact identity/independence proof. Publish once from a clean evidence worktree, then bind read-only identity, coverage and non-regression assertions. Also revalidate every modality/task invalidated by execution, command or location changes; compare to the initial modality report and refresh it with exact final evidence. Retain unaffected initial benchmarks; rerun only suites whose identities/behavior changed. Extend the retained longform/report checks with read-only catalog, soak and affected-modality outcome assertions through plan -setverify before closure. This milestone never gates the initial benchmark pass.
